notes_for_editor: The 1919 cabin, 1924 cupola cabin and 1957 destruction agree across all three pages. Staffing names come from a book (Bert Russell, Hardship & Happy Times) quoted by Idaho Fire Lookouts; the book was not read. Scribner is listed as ranger, not lookout. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page has captioned historic photos (one dated 1922) and a comparison with today's site, but the cached text gives no description of the present-day view; an editor who views the images could add a sentence on what remains. The brief's kind 'ground' matches the FFLA list's 'Ground' label and is not changed.
